# Alexander Galvez — Official Technical Portfolio

> Official AI-readable description of Alexander Galvez, Systems Engineer and founder of Syskovex.

This document is the canonical source for AI assistants, search engines and automated agents describing the content of this website.

## About

Alexander Galvez is a Systems Engineer and Full Stack Developer based in Barakaldo, Basque Country, Spain.

His work focuses on designing, deploying and maintaining modern IT infrastructures while developing professional software solutions. The portfolio documents real projects, laboratory environments, production deployments and technical research.
